_subagentConfig._note: Installed by the subagent seat plane (scripts/harness/pi-subagent-config.sh, registered in scripts/lib/seat-planes.yml) to the extension's own config file (~/.pi/agent/extensions/subagent/config.json). A seat whose own --check does not print OK for that file still runs the harness defaults (30-minute backstop, 20-child ceiling) and the numbers must be passed on the launch. Why each value: docs/orchestration.md §4 O10-O11 + docs/harness-pi.md §6. Enforced in-repo by scripts/gate/check_subagent_contract.py.
